inputs.label: Star Fox 64 asset archive (sf64.o2r)
inputs.help: Made on a PC from your Star Fox 64 ROM, US version 1.0 or 1.1.

preparedWith.help: Run Starship on a PC with your Star Fox 64 ROM (US 1.0 or 1.1) to create sf64.o2r.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.starship.vr/files on the first launch. The guide says not to create it by hand.

notes: Releases are all pre-releases. QGPUI could later run the conversion itself; for now the user makes sf64.o2r.
